questions.text: The demand and production for five businesses V, W, X, Y, and Z are shown in the accompanying chart, which illustrates them using a basic bar graph to provide an answer. The difference between average demand and average production of the four companies (V, W, X, Y) taken together, is:
Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2500 as a sum borrowed at 6% per year rate of interest for 2 years.
Ram borrowed ₹20,000 at 6% per annum and ₹25,000 at 8% per annum, for the same duration. He had to pay ₹9,600 in all as interest. What is the time period?
If Mohan’s income is 20% less than Arvind’s income, then how much per cent is Arvind’s income more than Mohan’s income?
A train travelling at a speed of 36 km/h crosses a pole in 24 sec. What is the length of the train?
The HCF and LCM of two numbers are 11 and 3465, respectively. If one of the two numbers is 693, what is the other number?

A clothing store announces a discount scheme 'Buy one shirt and get 40% off on another shirt of the same price'. What is the profit percentage of the store, given that each shirt has a cost price 60% below the marked price?
Two trains are running in opposite directions at the same speed. If the length of each train is 150 m and they cross each other in 15 sec, find the speed of each train (in km/hr).
Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2500 as a sum borrowed at 8% per year rate of interest for 3 years.

In an examination, the average score of a student was 71.9. If the student would have got 28 more marks in English, 22 more marks in Mathematics, 16 more marks in Computer Science, 14 more marks in History, 10 less marks in Hindi, and retained the same marks in other subjects, then the average score would have been 80.65. How many subjects were there in the examination?

What is the ratio in which product A, costing ₹70 per 100 grams, should be mixed with product B, costing ₹100 per 100 grams, so that on selling the mixture at ₹1.20 per gram, a profit of 25% is achieved?
The average weight of X, Y and Z is 67 kg. The average weight of X and Y is 64 kg and that of Y and Z is 52 kg. The weight of Y (in kg) is:
If 80 workers took 25 days to finish a task,how many days will it take to finish the same task if 20 more workers join?

The x and y co-ordinates of six points are tabulated as below. Observe the table carefully and answer the given question. Points X-co-ordinate Y-co-ordinate A 15 42 B 20 46 C 18 44 D 16 48 E 21 50 F 22 52 Find the distance between F and C.
400 chickooes were bought at ₹1280 per hundred and were sold at a profit of ₹980. Find the selling price (in ₹) per dozen of chickooes.
The area of a right-angled triangle is 80m2. If its perpendicular is equal to 20 m, then find its base.

Mr Rao purchased a laptop for ₹45,000. After a few months, as his office provided another laptop, he sold it at a loss of 12% to Mrs Sharma. After one year, she sold it to an engineering student for a profit of 12%. What is the amount the student had to pay?
